reason: Removing System.Linq.Async is only safe if no code still uses IAsyncEnumerable LINQ extension methods from that package on non-net10 target frameworks, so there's a moderate chance of a build break on older TFMs if usage was missed, but it's a low-impact, easily-caught-by-CI dependency cleanup.
